headline: Northern Sectors Erupt in Relentless Clashes and Rapid Base Shifts
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch three hours ago, intense pressure along the northern front has sharpened into relentless combat, led by continued upheavals in Mooring County and Weathered Expanse. Mooring County remains the deadliest theater, sustaining over five thousand casualties in the last two hours while six base transitions shook The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast. Weathered Expanse matched that tempest with six base shifts of its own, driven by brutal fighting around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch. To the west, Callum's Cape absorbed more than forty-six hundred casualties in two hours as contention raged across Naofa and Scouts Jest, while Linn of Mercy recorded three further turnovers near Outwich Ranch. Marban Hollow, previously stalled, re-erupted with three base exchanges at Checkpoint Bua, leaving three garrisons for each faction alongside two contested ruins. Meanwhile, an offshore surge in Lykos Isle produced five sharp base transitions over The Squall and Fort Guile before Colonial forces solidified control. In contrast, sectors such as Stonecradle, Nevish Line, and Dead Lands have fallen notably quiet, recording no base transfers over the last six hours.
